title: Scrolling to a fragment should have consistent focus handling
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

## Current Spec

In [7.4.6.4 Scrolling to a fragment](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#scrolling-to-a-fragment) specifies:

> if document's [indicated part](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#the-indicated-part-of-the-document) is [top of the document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#top-of-the-document):
> 
> 1. Set document's [target element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#target-element) to null.
> 
> 2. [Scroll to the beginning of the document](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document) for document. [[CSSOMVIEW]](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/references.html#refsCSSOMVIEW)
> 
> 3. Return.

It doesn't however specify running the [focusing steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#focusing-steps) for target leaving the focus on the initiating link. As a result:
- There is a disconnect between view and cursor
- The behavior is not consistent regular fragments 
- The behavior creates an accessibility issue

## Expected Spec

To ensure a consistent behavior, the correct execution should be:

1. Set document's [target element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#target-element) to null.

2. [Scroll to the beginning of the document](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document) for document. [[CSSOMVIEW]](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/references.html#refsCSSOMVIEW)

3. Run the [focusing steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#focusing-steps) for target, with the [Document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#document)'s [viewport](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#viewport) as the fallback target.

4. Return.

## Demo

Both behaviors, current and expected can be tested in the following CodePen: https://codepen.io/editor/th3s4mur41/pen/019ecf95-41ec-77cf-9d8c-b35f76b7ea2a

### Current behavior
1. Hit the tab key until reaching the "Classic to top" link
2. Press enter
3. Viewport scrolls to the top, but focus remains on the link (see outline and background)
4. Tab one more time and the browser scrolls down to the footer again

### Expected behavior
1. Hit the tab key until reaching the "Accessible to top" link
2. Press enter
3. Viewport scrolls to the top, but focus is removed (no more background color) and body becomes the sequential focus navigation starting point
4. Tab one more time and focus is set on the first link of the document
